review.use_summary: Removed adapters and described quality trimming of 80-bp paired-end ATAC-seq/CUT&Tag reads with fastp 1.0.1 defaults before Bowtie2 mapping.
review.implementation_scope_note: The paper describes default processing, not explicit sliding-window cutting; v1.0.1 cut_front/cut_tail/cut_right are disabled by default. Header-dependent poly-G behavior and concrete inputs matter. FastQC, alignment, duplicate removal and peak calling are separate.

review.use_summary: Trimmed RNA-seq reads to 100 bp with fastp 0.22.0 before STAR/RSEM.
review.implementation_scope_note: The paper does not give a full command or the exact end/global-cutting option. max_len1=100 is an available caller-selected setting, not proof of the authors' command. Do not infer every library's pairing, adapter/poly-G settings or correction.

review.use_summary: Preprocessed paired-end short-read metagenomes with fastp 0.23.2, including PE adapter detection, overlap correction, right-side quality cutting, quality/length filtering and deduplication.
review.implementation_scope_note: Explicit options: --detect_adapter_for_pe --correction --cut_right --cut_right_window_size 4 --cut_right_mean_quality 20 --average_qual 30 --length_required 100 --dedup --dup_calc_accuracy 6. The paragraph also says barcode trimming but does not specify barcode identities/positions. Accuracy 6 requires 24 GiB for the source Bloom buffer plus overhead; do not silently lower it. GNU Parallel, pigz and downstream analyses remain separate.

review.use_summary: Used fastp v0.23 for WGS preprocessing, removing adapters and reads with over 40% Q<15 bases, then retaining clean reads of at least 45 bp before BWA/SAMtools/Picard.
review.implementation_scope_note: The v0.23 patch is unresolved; do not silently equate it to 0.23.2 or another edition. Reported thresholds are qualified_quality_phred 15, unqualified_percent_limit 40 and length_required 45; full effective options and header-driven behavior are not reported.

review.use_summary: Used fastp to trim ChIP-seq reads before Bowtie2 mapping and downstream Sambamba, deepTools, IGV and MACS3 analysis.
review.implementation_scope_note: The fastp version and complete effective options are unreported. Do not infer a fastp edition, adapter, window, poly-G or quality threshold from the downstream tools or protocols.

review.use_summary: Applied fastp standard adapter/quality trimming to ATAC-seq reads before Bowtie2 mapping and subsequent read/peak/promoter processing.
review.implementation_scope_note: The paragraph reports standard settings but no fastp version or complete command. Defaults are version/header dependent. GNU Parallel, mitochondrial/ENCODE filtering, SAMtools, MACS2 and BEDTools are separate steps.

review.use_summary: Applied default fastp 0.25.0 quality assessment/preprocessing to resequencing reads before BWA-MEM alignment, Picard duplicate removal and GATK variant calling.
review.implementation_scope_note: Do not invent additional filtering or cutting flags from the phrase quality assessment/default settings. Exact input/output choices and effective header-dependent behavior are not reported. Read preprocessing does not reproduce alignments, variant calling or the 422-accession/186-RIL study.
